In this 30-functional-Pirate list, the persistent wide evasion is more aligned with three-Pirates-per-opponent combat trigger.
reviewer_notes: No matched multiplayer game test available; card choice supported by rules text, deck-role analysis and current cohort data, not by a win-rate claim.; Cast using spare/low-impact creatures where possible; using creatures needed to attack this turn as convokers sacrifices their immediate attack.
